audit.whatIsWrong: Quinn's E is labelled 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' throughout the full layer (focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[5].t, report[9].t), and the content layer says it 'knocks you back' in whys[1], spikes[0].text, content early and wants.foe[1].
audit.why: Neither half is right. Riot's Vault: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.' There is no blind on it — the vision effect is on her Q, Blinding Assault ('mark an enemy and hinder its vision'). And it does not knock Graves back; SHE relocates. That distinction decides the matchup: Graves is not displaced, so he does not have to re-close from where he was thrown — he has to cover the distance she just put between them, while slowed and briefly interrupted. The brief interrupt is also unmentioned anywhere and it is what cuts his attack string.
audit.corrected: Vault is a dash that damages, slows, briefly interrupts, and lands HER at her maximum attack range. The vision hinder belongs to Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s).
sources: enemyKit E Riot text, range 675, cd 12/11/10/9/8

audit.whatIsWrong: The move-speed that lets her kite and roam is credited to 'Harrier move-speed' in whys[6], spikes[2].text, content late and wants.foe[2].
audit.why: Riot's Harrier is a mark and a bonus-damage first attack only: 'Valor... periodically marks enemies with Harrier. Quinn's first basic attack against Harrier targets will deal bonus physical damage.' The speed is on Heightened Senses (W): 'Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target.' The player needs to know it is conditional on her landing that empowered attack — deny the Harrier proc and the kiting speed does not turn on.
audit.corrected: Named Heightened Senses (W) as the source of the attack speed and move speed.
sources: enemyKit P and W Riot text, W cd 50/45/40/35/30

audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[] and the full-layer phases both read Skill / Quinn / Quinn / Skill / Skill / Quinn / Quinn, against a packet levelChart of Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Graves / Graves / Quinn. The lane is tagged EVEN at 5.5/10 on a 40% win rate.
audit.why: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 5 are wrong in both layers, and the content whys agree with the packet against them: whys[0] 'her Harrier empowered autos poke you for free' (Quinn), whys[3] 'she pokes you down across Levels 4-5' (Quinn), whys[4] 'Collateral Damage is your one ranged nuke' (Graves), whys[5] 'Your Eclipse / Essence Reaver spike finally lets a full combo chunk her' (Graves). A 40% lane is not even.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Graves / Graves / Quinn, ratings 3,3,3,3,6,6,3; diff HARD, difficulty 7/10, Quinn carry threat 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer marks Level 6 and first item as Skill/Quinn stages at 4-5/10 and describes them with generic boilerplate, while the content layer correctly identifies both as Graves' only windows.
audit.why: Collateral Damage is the only thing in Graves' kit that reaches Quinn without closing the gap, so Level 6 is his spike; the first item is the second, and both are conditional on Vault (12/11/10/9/8s) already being spent. Behind Enemy Lines is a travel ultimate, not a combat one — Riot: 'Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed' — so her Level 6 is a map spike, not a duel spike, which is exactly why Graves' Level 6 is where the chart turns.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and [5] flipped to Graves and rewritten around Vault's cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: content mid says W smoke means 'the cloud blinds and slows her'; report[10].t and phases[6].why also call it a blind.
audit.why: Riot's Smoke Screen: 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' The slow and the vision cut are real and both matter against a poke champion; the blind is not.
audit.corrected: Described as impact slow plus vision cut, with the blind claim removed.
sources: ownerKit W Riot text and flags

audit.why: 12/11/10/9/8s. 'Eight seconds where she cannot leave your point-blank range' is the concrete instruction the whole page is circling.

edits.before: She owns the first three levels outright. Her Harrier passive procs a free empowered auto every time you walk up to CS, and at Level 1 you have no Quickdraw charge to close that gap, so you just eat poke and reload an empty 2-shot magazine. Don't dash in early: the instant you E toward her she Vaults (E) over you, knocking you back, then Harrier-kites away. If you do commit, her Q (Blinding Assault) nearsights you so your point-blank shells whiff. Last-hit at max range off the tip of your Q powder trail, eat the lost CS, and wait for 6.
edits.after: She owns the first four levels outright. Her Harrier passive procs a free empowered auto every time you walk up to CS, and at Level 1 you have no Quickdraw charge to close that gap, so you just eat poke and reload an empty magazine. Don't dash in early: the instant you E toward her she Vaults (E) onto you, slows and briefly interrupts you, then lands a full attack range away and kites off Heightened Senses. If you do commit, her Q (Blinding Assault) hinders your vision from 1025 range. Last-hit at max range off the tip of your Q powder trail, eat the lost CS, and wait for 6.

edits.before: Level 6 is your single best window and you have to abuse it. The lane hinges on her Vault (E), her only escape and her get-out from your dash, so bait it first: feint a Quickdraw step-in, make her blow Vault on the knockback, then E-in for the point-blank shell spread and Q-cone. Crucially, Collateral Damage reaches her at range, so it's your follow-up if she's still backpedaling. W (Smoke Screen) her Harrier kite-path so the cloud blinds and slows her and cuts the vision she needs to poke you out of the all-in. If Vault is up you can't pin her down, so back off and don't feed.
edits.after: Level 6 is your single best window and you have to abuse it. The lane hinges on her Vault (E), her only escape and her get-out from your dash, so bait it first: feint a Quickdraw step-in, make her spend Vault, then E-in for the point-blank shell spread and Q-cone inside its twelve-second cooldown. Crucially, Collateral Damage reaches her at range, so it's your follow-up if she's still backpedaling. W (Smoke Screen) her kite-path — it slows on impact and cuts the vision she needs to poke you out of the all-in, though it never blinds. If Vault is up you can't pin her down, so back off and don't feed.

edits.before: Even with your Eclipse / Essence Reaver spike you never get to dictate this lane, because she just leaves it. Quinn roams with Harrier move-speed and turns a farm lane into a 2v1 elsewhere, so your job is to not lose tempo: shove the wave with Q, then match her roams or cross-map and look for a long-range Collateral Damage pick when she over-extends without Vault. Realistically you won't solo-kill a Quinn who respects the matchup, so make the map your win condition before her poke and roam pressure decide the game.

notes: Suspect name 'If Vault' flagged in content mid is a FALSE POSITIVE — Vault is Quinn's real E name; that sentence was fine. The genuine naming error was elsewhere and ran through the whole full layer: Quinn's E is labelled 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' in ten fields. Vault has no blind — Riot's text is a dash that damages, slows, briefly interrupts, and lands HER at maximum attack range. The vision hinder belongs to Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range). Two consequences the page had backwards: (1) the content layer said Vault 'knocks you back' four times, when in fact Graves is not displaced at all — she leaves, which changes what re-closing costs him; (2) the brief interrupt on Vault, which cuts his attack string mid-magazine, was never mentioned. Second real fix: the kiting and roaming move speed was credited to Harrier in four fields. Harrier is only a mark plus a bonus-damage first attack; the speed is Heightened Senses (W) and it is conditional on her landing the Harrier-empowered attack — so denying that proc denies the speed. Smoke Screen was called a blind in three places. Level chart wrong at four rows in both layers, with the content whys already matching the packet. NOTE ON DATA: packet.games is null for this matchup while the brief's top-level games field says 1115 — I treated it as having data and audited it rather than deferring, since a 40% win rate and a full level chart are present; if the applier requires a non-null games count this one may need a second look.
